name: BOUNDARY_CERTIFICATE_ELIMINATION_GRAMMAR
maxwell_design_exemplar: Faraday + Ampere-Maxwell + Gauss can be composed to eliminate an internal field and obtain a closed wave equation. BCEG asks whether exact SAT certificate chains can eliminate internal variables while keeping all live boundary and discovery resources polynomial.
exact_claim_if_future_lemma_is_proved: If for every arbitrary CNF F of input bitlength n a BCEG chain exists, is discoverable without witness leakage, preserves SAT/UNSAT equivalence at every projection, and has total discovery + representation + interface + canonicalization + verification volume bounded by poly(n), then BCEG yields a deterministic polynomial-time decision algorithm for CNF-SAT, and because SAT is NP-complete this would imply P=NP.

required_unproved_lemma.name: UNIVERSAL_POLYNOMIAL_BOUNDARY_ELIMINATION_LEMMA
required_unproved_lemma.statement: For every arbitrary CNF F of input bitlength n, there exists a witness-independent, deterministically discoverable sequence of exact typed certificate compositions and internal-variable eliminations that preserves satisfiability and whose cumulative certificate-discovery work, proof-DAG representation volume, live-interface volume, projection/canonicalization work and verification work are all bounded by poly(n).
required_unproved_lemma.why_it_is_the_whole_problem: Without this lemma BCEG can collapse to known resolution/Davis-Putnam-style variable elimination, which can suffer exponential width or size blow-up.
